banh-xeo-mien-tay.name: Mekong Delta Banh Xeo
aliases: Mekong Delta shrimp and pork banh xeo
banh-xeo-mien-tay.serving_basis: Four large Mekong Delta-style pancakes filled with shrimp, pork and bean sprouts, wrapped in fresh greens and served with sweet-sour fish sauce.
banh-xeo-mien-tay.description: A large Mekong Delta-style banh xeo with a thin crisp edge and a shrimp, pork belly and bean sprout filling. This batter variant combines rice flour with crispy-frying flour, egg, sparkling water and coconut milk; wrap it in greens and dip in fish sauce.
banh-xeo-mien-tay.finished_dish: The turmeric-yellow pancake has a crisp edge and tender center, with shrimp, pork and bean sprouts in the filling. Sparkling water and crispy-frying flour help form the crisp shell; coconut milk adds light richness.
banh-xeo-mien-tay.image_alt: A large Mekong Delta banh xeo with a crisp golden shell, shrimp, pork and bean sprouts, served with fresh greens.
search_terms: Mekong Delta shrimp and pork banh xeo
tips: Rest the batter for about 30 minutes and stir it again before each ladle.
Use a hot pan with a thin film of oil and swirl the batter quickly around the sides.
Add bean sprouts near the end and uncover the pan so steam escapes and the edge stays crisp.
preparation_steps: Whisk rice flour, crispy-frying flour, turmeric and salt with egg, sparkling water and coconut milk until smooth. Stir in scallions and rest for 30 minutes.
Slice pork belly thinly, clean shrimp and cut onion into wedges. Rinse and drain bean sprouts and greens; mince garlic and chili for the dipping sauce.
Mix fish sauce with sugar, lime juice, garlic, chili and 70 ml warm water. Taste and adjust the sweet-sour balance.
cooking_steps: Heat a pan with a little oil and stir-fry pork until nearly cooked. Add shrimp and onion; cook until shrimp turn pink, then remove the filling.
Lightly oil the hot pan and swirl in a thin layer of batter. Add filling to one half and scatter bean sprouts over it; cover for about a minute.
Uncover and cook over medium heat until the edges are dry and crisp and the center is set. Fold the pancake and transfer to a plate; repeat with remaining batter.

keywords: Mekong Delta shrimp and pork banh xeo

banh-xeo-mien-tay.serving: Serve the pancake hot with lettuce, mustard greens, fresh herbs and sweet-sour fish sauce. Tear off pieces and wrap them with greens.
